facts.claim: Editor actions are mounted in Scaffold.bottomNavigationBar without viewInsets handling.
Prompt-generation sheet uses a fixed 92% screen height and a scroll ListView for the setup form.
Home order is hero, writing settings, API-key notice, then recent drafts.
Settings renders test-connection as filled and save-key as outlined.
Widget tests implement concrete repository classes with in-memory fakes.

unknowns: True AI candidate/grading runtime states require a DeepSeek key and were not captured.
